title: Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Scientific Literature
abstract: We present a method for combining dense retrieval with large language models to answer questions over a corpus of research papers.

title: Hybrid Search Strategies for Academic Question Answering
abstract: This paper explores the combination of BM25 keyword search and vector similarity to improve retrieval quality in academic settings.

title: Chunking Strategies for Long Scientific Documents
abstract: We evaluate several chunking approaches and their effect on downstream retrieval and answer accuracy.
